description: Search Florida listings through IDX Broker. Provide community OR zipcode (zipcode overrides community). listingIds overrides every filter except sort. Sort 'pra' requires mip; sort 'sqfta' requires sqft. Returns up to 25 results by default plus a searchURL to share with the client.

daysOld.description: Maximum number of days since the listing was created

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25)

listing_ids.description: Exact MLS listing IDs to look up directly

minimumPrice.description: Required when sorting by low-to-high price

property_type.description: The sub-category of properties to include in the search; sfr = Single Family Residential, rnt = Rental, lse = Lease

sort.description: How to sort the results (note that only the top 25 will be returned by default); newest = newest listings, oldest = oldest listings, pra = least expensive to most (requires minimum asking price parameter), prd = most expensive to least, bda = bedrooms (low to high), bdd = bedrooms (high to low), tba = bathrooms (low to high) tbd = bathrooms (high to low), sqfta = square footage (low to high, requires sqft parameter), sqftd = square footage (high to low)

sqft.description: Required when sorting by low-to-high square footage

yearBuilt.description: Set to current year for 'New Construction'

name: search_properties
title: Search Properties
